name: rankly-video
description: Rankly launch and how-it-works videos, built with Remotion

scripts.render:how: remotion render src/index.ts HowItWorks out/how-rankly-works.mp4 --crf=28 && npm run compress:how
scripts.compress:how: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/how-rankly-works.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -tune animation -crf 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an ../public/videos/how-rankly-works.mp4
